summary: Round-1 fix only half landed: the starfield seam in section 8 is gone, but the 'approaching mountain' is still unreadable — at ~75 s it is a grey tombstone-shaped pillar rising through the caption, then a flat dark dome whose detector sits under the 'イメージ図' label, and at ~85 s the Hacozy icon is perched on that detector.
